# Intearior

> Nationwide directory of interior design studios — full-home design, kitchen & bath, renovation management, staging, and e-design, ranked by real client reviews.

Intearior helps homeowners find verified, currently-operating interior design studios across the United States. Listings are continuously refreshed and no studio pays for placement.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and browse trusted interior design studios nationwide.
- [Search](/search): Search studios by name, city, service, or style.
- [Match](/match): Take a quick quiz to get matched with studios suited to your project.
- [Guide](/guide): Editorial guides on services and design styles.
- [Submit a business](/submit): Suggest an interior design studio for the directory.
- [For Business](/for-business): Claim or submit your studio listing.
- [About](/about): What Intearior is and how listings are vetted.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team for corrections, partnerships, or support.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How we handle your data and third-party sources.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use and directory disclaimers.

## Directory structure

- [Designers by state and city](/designers/{state}/{city}): Interior design studios listed by state and city, e.g. /designers/ca/los-angeles.
- [Service pages](/service/{slug}): Studios offering a specific service, e.g. /service/kitchen-and-bath.
- [Style pages](/style/{slug}): Studios specializing in a design style, e.g. /style/modern.
